business: ConvoTrack: iOS app for group motorcycle rides (live group map, regroup, emergency alert, invite codes, ride roles, ride summary). 3-day free trial, then Pro subscription.
target: Motorcycle riders aged 20-60 who ride in groups of 4-40, in India (weekend clubs, RE/KTM groups, Ladakh/Goa trips), the UK (rideouts, bike-meet groups, older touring riders) and the US (touring, Harley/adventure groups); both organisers and regular members.
where: App Store search: India (en-GB / hi listing), UK (en-GB), US (en-US)

behaviours.name: Ride leader / organiser
behaviours.how: Plans the route, runs the WhatsApp or Facebook group, chooses the tools the group uses.

behaviours.name: Regular member
behaviours.how: Installs whatever the leader sends; rarely searches for ride apps alone.

objections: Everyone in the group has to install it or it is useless
WhatsApp live location / intercom / the drop-off system already does this
No signal on the routes we ride
Subscription after a short trial; do members pay too?
Not clear what it is: tracker, sat-nav or logger?
Battery drain on a long ride
habits: shares WhatsApp live location before rides
owns a Sena or Cardo intercom
does one long trip a year
_note: Guessed from the brief and the listing; no real customer interviews used.
